key_insight: Using the entrywise maximum matrix norm yields an exact mixed-integer quadratic reformulation of distributionally robust chance-constrained quadratic optimization over the simplex.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports decisions such as portfolio allocation under distributional uncertainty modeled by a Wasserstein ball around an empirical distribution.
method: Minimize worst-case Value-at-Risk of a random quadratic form over the standard simplex.
Exploit linear dependence on the uncertain matrix to derive a mixed-integer quadratic reformulation.
Use the entrywise maximum norm for an exact reformulation and characterize the induced worst-case distribution.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments on positive-definite and indefinite instances assess how model parameters affect optimal values and solution times, highlighting the computational cost of indefiniteness.
watch_item: An exact reformulation does not eliminate nonconvexity or NP-hardness; indefinite instances can remain computationally demanding.
paper_title: Distributionally robust chance-constrained standard quadratic optimization with Wasserstein ambiguity
